description: Discord's historical record of administrative actions: who did what, to what, when, and why. Use this to investigate what already happened; for activity as it happens use subscribe_events. Filter by action name (like channel_create, member_ban_add, message_delete) or by the acting user. Discord merges some actions repeated in quick succession (message deletes, member moves and disconnects, channel and role reordering) into one entry that keeps only the first reason.

action.description: Action name filter, like channel_delete or member_kick.

guild.description: Guild (server) name or ID. Omit to use the default guild.

user.description: Only entries by this user (name or ID).

name: get_audit_log
title: Get audit log
